## Cross-team impact

List affected owners, interface changes, and coordination needed, or write "None".

## Validation

Describe checks actually performed and results. During the structure-only phase,
check placement, documentation links, and instruction/ownership scope. Do not
claim application builds or tests ran when no tooling exists yet.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes stay within the team's area, or affected owners are consulted.
- [ ] Local working instructions are followed.
- [ ] Relevant reviewers are requested manually until CODEOWNERS is activated.
- [ ] No imports of another area's private implementation are introduced.
- [ ] API/authentication/authorization changes are coordinated with the backend team, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, production configuration, or real student data are included.
- [ ] Central portal publishing remains controlled by the portal maintainer.
